title: Unified Choice/Effect Test Story
author: Test
description: Tests the unified choice/effect formats: MovementChoice effects bug fix, counter fields, and sound effects

parameters.text:
Welcome, brave adventurer! Your journey will test the new unified choice/effect system.

Your starting stats:
- Courage: 0
- Wisdom: 0
- Gold: 0

Let's see how your choices affect these counters!

parameters.question:
You stand at a crossroads. Where will you go?

(Testing: MovementChoice with effects array AND counter fields)

choices.text: Take the dangerous mountain path (+5 Courage, sets 'chose_mountain' variable)
Take the scholarly forest route (+3 Wisdom)
Search the abandoned camp (set Gold to 10)

parameters.text:
You braved the mountain path!

✓ Effects array applied: 'chose_mountain' variable is now TRUE
✓ Counter field applied: Courage increased by 5

This proves the MovementChoice effects bug is FIXED!

You took the scholarly forest route!

✓ Counter field applied: Wisdom increased by 3

You searched the abandoned camp!

✓ Counter field applied: Gold SET to 10 (not incremented)

parameters.question:
You find a treasure chest with three items. Pick one!

(Testing: PickProp with counter fields - item also added to inventory)

parameters.text:
Excellent choice!

✓ Item added to inventory (check your inventory!)
✓ Counter increased based on your choice

Now let's test the DialogTree with counter fields...

dialogTree.speaker: Wise Sage
dialogTree.text:
Greetings, traveler! I sense great potential in you. Tell me, what trait do you value most?

(Testing: DialogTree with counter fields on choices)

choices.text: I value bravery above all else! (+5 Courage)

dialogNode.speaker: Wise Sage
dialogNode.text:
A noble answer! Courage will serve you well. Your courage has increased!

Now, one final question...

choices.text: Knowledge is the greatest treasure. (+5 Wisdom)

dialogNode.speaker: Wise Sage
dialogNode.text:
Indeed! The pursuit of wisdom is admirable. Your wisdom has grown!

Now, one final question...

dialogNode.speaker: Wise Sage
dialogNode.text:
Practical! Wealth has its uses. Your gold has increased!

Now, one final question...

choices.text: Time is money, let's move on.

parameters.text:
=== FINAL STATS ===

Your adventure has tested all the new unified choice/effect features:

✓ MovementChoice effects array (BUG FIX)
✓ MovementChoice counter fields
✓ PickProp counter fields (with inventory add)
✓ DialogTree counter fields

Check the browser console or debug panel to verify your final counter values!

parameters.message:
Test Complete!

All unified choice/effect features have been tested.
